landedCommits.author: Mark Schaake

verdict.rationale: The failure summary shows `plans: []`, `modelsUsed: []`, and `failedAt` matching the enqueue commit timestamp exactly (`2026-05-22T08:23:52-07:00`). The only landed commit is the enqueue commit itself, which added only the PRD file (389 lines, no implementation). No agent was ever invoked — the build session failed before any planning or implementation work began. This pattern is consistent with a transient infrastructure failure at build startup (worker failed to pick up the queue item, daemon issue, or scheduler error) rather than a content or logic problem with the PRD. The PRD itself is complete, well-specified, and intact on the feature branch. However, the failure summary is marked `partial: true` and does not include an error message, so the exact transient cause cannot be confirmed — medium confidence rather than high.
